page.overview:
Who is Asha?

Asha was a fierce huntress in Ewok mythology. "Asha" was a popular name for female Ewok children,

Asha was mentioned in the Galactic Campaign Guide, a 2003 supplement for Wizards of the Coast's Star Wars Roleplaying Game that was written by Peter Schweighofer and J.D. Wiker.
